reserveReview.rationale: The single slice identifies the direct government-MMF shareholder claim, matching the live adapter's exact class 4397 key, rather than fabricating current Treasury/repo/cash percentages from NAV. The September 30 factsheet reports 55.3% U.S. Treasury debt and 44.7% U.S. Treasury repos; these are dated sector weights, not October 14 holdings. The series S000101820 N-MFP3 for September 30, filed October 7, discloses ten portfolio-security lines comprising Treasury debt and Treasury repos, with Citigroup Global Markets, BofA Securities and Wells Fargo Securities named on the repo positions. This monthly regulatory schedule establishes dated security-level composition and counterparties, not current holdings or independent assurance. The current prospectus confirms the 93-day Treasury purchase limit, fully collateralized overnight repos and cash held primarily for redemptions. The October 14 issuer reports NAV $1, WAM/WAL 9 days and daily/weekly liquid assets 99.99%. These are issuer disclosures, not independent assurance or unconditional cash capacity. Redemptions worth $250,000 or more may be paid partly or wholly in readily marketable securities valued at NAV; selling them adds market, tax and transaction-cost exposure.
